market.selections: mapping of stable selection key to decimal odds; complete for the exact same product

features: mapping of feature name to {value, available_at, availability_basis, source_id}; null is missing, not an observed zero
sources: list of {source_id, path_or_url, sha256, received_at, availability_basis}; no invented receipt timestamps
label_storage: separate labels.jsonl keyed by fixture_id and market_id; include official scores/result, received_at, revision and settlement rule
